_comment: server_ip is PINNED, not 'auto'. This host also carries a macvlan (mac0, .133) used for VM testing, and auto-detection picks whichever address it finds first - which pointed real hardware at an interface it could not TFTP from. Pin it.
_never_offer_comment: MACs here are NEVER offered a boot file, whatever the timed hold says. The 6h hold always expires and these boxes boot from the network FIRST, so an expired hold means a finished install gets silently reimaged. Remove a MAC here to allow it to install again.
_localboot_comment: A HELD MAC here is ANSWERED with a PXE 'boot from local disk' menu (option 43, menu item type 0, prompt timeout 0) instead of silence. Some ROMs never fall through on silence: the Dell Dimension 4600's Intel Boot Agent sat on 'DHCP' until someone pressed F12 (2026-09-26). Machines not held still get the normal boot file.
